anker - soundcore liberty 5 pro max nois.description: The soundcore Liberty 5 Pro Max by Anker helps you stay organized, focused, and in control with advanced AI features and an intuitive case display. Whether you're in meetings, classes, or interviews, the AI note-taking feature automatically transcribes conversations in real time and generates summaries with key action items, so you always have a clear record. A 1.78" AMOLED touchscreen on the charging case provides direct access to settings, noise control, and tools like the AI voice recorder without reaching for your phone. Multiple sensors and the Thus™ AI Chip help keep your voice clear on calls, while adaptive noise cancelling reduces background distractions. HearID 5.0 delivers a personalized sound profile, and built-in voice commands let you skip tracks, take calls, and adjust volume hands-free, even without an internet connection.
